caching_conditions_from_guide.minimum_applies_to: GPT-5.6 and later (guide wording); gpt-6-luna is not named in the guide
caching_conditions_from_guide.prefix_rule: Cache reuse requires the entire rendered prefix to match (instructions, tool definitions, history, images).
caching_conditions_from_guide.default: Prompt caching is enabled by default for supported models (implicit mode places breakpoints automatically).
caching_conditions_from_guide.write_cost: 30-minute writes 1.25x uncached input; 12-hour writes (Responses API only) 2.5x; total rates, not surcharges
caching_conditions_from_guide.lifetime: default minimum 30 minutes; prompt_cache_options.ttl='12h' in the Responses API
